# tls-check

> Inspect TLS certificate chains and handshakes: expiry, hostname, weak keys and signatures, validity length, trust and protocol version, with stable finding codes Go module `github.com/Trysac/u162-tls-check`, package `tlscheck`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
